summary: Shell plugins make sure the basic commands Ansible runs are formatted correctly for the target, and they let users configure some execution behaviors.
questions: What do shell plugins do in Ansible?
Why does Ansible care what shell the target uses?

answer_card.title: What shell plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Shell plugins format the low-level commands Ansible runs so they work on the target, and they expose some settings for how tasks execute.
